subject: Re: CoroTech POC — one-time credit uplift & short-term term waiver

Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: additional POC credits & short term waiver

Ben — thanks for the quick demo last week. The engineering team is happy with inference quality; we are now ramping a cross-team evaluation (search, summarization, reranking). Two asks before we can move to a paid pilot: 

1) Can Redwood provide a one-time credit uplift (we estimate ~150k extra tokens) to finish a 3-week expanded evaluation window?
2) Because our procurement cycle is slower (legal + security review), can we get a 30-day extension on the standard PLG sandbox term while we finalize PO paperwork?

We attached the SOW with target tests and a condensed usage log. We understand these are non-standard requests — happy to sign a short addendum if required.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Director, Applied ML
CoroTech

Attachments: CoroTech_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf), POC-usage-log.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: additional POC credits & short term waiver

Forwarding CoroTech's ask — they need a one-time 150k token uplift and a 30-day PLG sandbox extension while procurement completes. Key points:
- Good technical fit; engineering said model matched their distribution in staging.
- High chance to convert to a reserved/Dedicated contract if POC shows throughput improvements.
- They asked explicitly for a short term waiver (we may need to limit liability / data terms).

Jordan / Laura — can you advise on approval path? Jordan: would this qualify for an exec exception? Laura: if legal needs a quick addendum, can we provide a one-page waiver template?

— Ben
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: additional POC credits & short term waiver

Ben — thanks. Quick internal context for execs:
- CoroTech is a mid-market analytics vendor with national customers; if successful this pilot could lead to a Dedicated contract (estimated $60k/mo).
- They've completed 2/3 of the test matrix; remaining runs are heavy on embedding + rerank which burn tokens quickly.
- Standard PLG limits are 30k token top-ups and 14 days; they are asking for 150k and 30 days.

Recommendation: approve a one-time 125k token uplift (to cover the most expensive tests) and a 30-day extension contingent on 3 conditions:
  * CoroTech signs a short addendum acknowledging the limited one-off uplift and agreeing to a joint case study if they convert within 6 months,
  * We add a soft cap on tokens for the extended window (automatic throttling at +20% over the uplift),
  * Legal to confirm the addendum limits our exposure (no new indemnities).

If execs are OK, I propose Aditya sign off on the uplift and attach the proposed addendum; Laura please draft the minimal addendum template (1 page) and confirm if any additional approvals required.

— Jordan

Attachment: internal-pilot-eval-summary.pdf (internal)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 14:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Re: Fwd: Request: additional POC credits & short term waiver

Approving per Jordan's recommendation with slight modifications. Approvals:
- One-time credit uplift: APPROVED for 125,000 tokens. This is a hard, non-recurring grant tied to deal_id RW-2028-0123-CT.
- Sandbox extension: APPROVED for 30 days, start date to be Ben's confirmation when they opt-in.

Conditions:
1) CoroTech must sign the 1-page addendum drafted by Legal that includes the token grant, start/end dates, and a case study opt-in clause. If they decline the case study, we reduce uplift to 75k tokens.
2) Add an automatic throttle: after the 125k grant is consumed, traffic will be throttled to baseline PLG rates.
3) Finance to record this as a marketing/GTN one-off expense; Ben, please route a short cost summary to finance after uplift is granted.
4) This approval is valid for 7 days — if we don't receive the signed addendum within a week, the uplift offer is rescinded.

Laura — please prepare the addendum & redline to the procurement mailbox. Ben — coordinate the timeline and confirm start date with the customer.

— Aditya
